'''Business and economy'''
*[[Decline of newspapers]]
**[[Newspapers in the United States|American newspaper]] ''[[The Washington Post]]'' announces that it will [[layoff|lay off]] about 300 journalists, roughly one-third of its employees, particularly those who cover [[Sports journalism|sports]], [[local news]], and [[world news]] sections as part of a major restructuring effort. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyn05d1494o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025–26 Asian winter]]
**The death toll from [[severe weather]] in [[Japan]], including heavy [[snow|snowfall]], rises to 35 with at least 400 others injured, according to the [[Government of Japan|Japanese government]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/at-least-35-killed-after-weeks-of-heavy-snowfall-in-japan-13503063 (Sky News)]
*[[2025–26 European windstorm season]]
**One person is killed, another is injured, a girl is reported missing and thousands are evacuated during [[flood]]s caused by [[2025–26 European windstorm season#Storm Leonardo|Storm Leonardo]] in [[Portugal]] and [[Spain]]. *Nine [[Local government in the Philippines|city government]] employees are killed when a [[dump truck]], also carrying [[crude oil]], falls into a river in [[Bayawan]], [[Negros Oriental]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/regions/2026/2/4/9-government-employees-killed-in-negros-oriental-road-mishap-1537 (ABS-CBN News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Eswatini–United States relations]], [[Deportation in the second Trump administration]]
**[[Eswatini]]'s [[Judiciary of eSwatini|high court]] upholds an agreement with the [[United States]] that accepts third-country deportees in exchange for $5.1 million and at least 15 transfers initiated during [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|the presidency]] of [[Donald Trump]], rejecting claims that the deal requires [[Parliament of Eswatini|parliamentary]] approval or greater disclosure. [https://www.reuters.com/world/eswatini-high-court-dismisses-case-challenging-deal-us-deportees-2026-02-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Venezuela]]n businessmen [[Raúl Gorrín]] and [[Alex Saab]], both allied with ''[[de jure]]'' [[President of Venezuela|president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]], are arrested in [[Caracas]] during a joint operation with [[Federal law enforcement in the United States|U.S. law enforcement]] agencies on [[Corruption in Venezuela|bribery]] and [[money laundering]] charges, with Saab expected to be [[Extradition law in the United States|extradited to the U.S.]] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuelan-official-saab-formerly-held-us-arrested-again-colombian-media-2026-02-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Elbit Systems burglary]]
**The [[Woolwich Crown Court]] finds three out of six members of [[Palestine Action]] not guilty of [[aggravated robbery]] relating to a raid on a building owned by Israeli weapons manufacturer [[Elbit Systems]] in [[Bristol]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], while charges on criminal damage and violent disorder received partial or no verdicts. Five are released on [[bail]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c9wxlv99xrjo (BBC News)]
*[[2025 North Sea ship collision]]
**A cargo ship captain is sentenced to six years in [[HM Prison Service|prison]] for [[gross negligence]] after his ship collided with an [[oil tanker]] in the [[North Sea]] off the coast of [[East Riding of Yorkshire]], [[England]], UK, in 2025, killing one person. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c801zgpm3meo (BBC News)]
*[[Attempted assassination of Donald Trump in Florida]]
**[[Ryan Wesley Routh]], the man who attempted to [[Assassination|assassinate]] [[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] while he was [[Donald Trump and golf|golf]]ing at [[Trump International Golf Club (West Palm Beach)|his club]] in [[West Palm Beach, Florida|West Palm Beach]], [[Florida]], in 2024, is sentenced to [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life in prison]] without the possibility of [[parole]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/04/us/ryan-routh-trump-assassination-attempt-sentence.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Budapest Complex]]
**A [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[Judiciary of Hungary|court]] sentences German activist [[Maja T.]] to eight years in prison for participating in assaults on attendees of a [[Far-right politics|far-right]] rally in [[Budapest]] in 2023, following her extradition from [[Germany]] despite later objections by [[Federal Constitutional Court|Germany's constitutional court]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/hungarian-court-sentences-german-anti-fascist-activist-8-129849548 (AP via ABC News)]
